item.title: Amazon DynamoDB now supports real-time vector search at any scale
item.dc:creator: Esra Kayabali
item.description: DynamoDB now supports native vector search with single-digit millisecond latency at 99%+ recall. It is designed for any scale, even trillions of vectors and requires zero infrastructure management.
